Birthplace must remain a place/mobility fact.
Citizenship must remain a legal/institutional fact.
Ethnocultural self-identification must remain self-concept.
Cultural background/exposure must remain culture/language context.
Sex characteristics must remain body/health information.
Gender expression must not collapse into sex characteristics.
Self-efficacy must remain a cognition/belief, not ability.
Knowledge/ability content must remain distinct from efficacy beliefs.
Taking/leaving a role must be represented as an event.
The resulting work role must remain a role.
Current mood must remain a dynamic state.
Big Five must remain a trait model, not current state.
Relationship-specific quality must remain on the relationship.
General relational tendencies must remain person-level dispositions.
Usable social resources must remain a projection/resource concept.
